actions.action: Show fulfillment separately for every requested item
actions.mechanism: Calculate physical fulfillment from linked receipts; display supplier promises separately from received quantities.
actions.implementation: Add a shared item register beside existing records: requested quantity, confirmed quantity, received quantity, remaining quantity, and receipt links. Aggregate multiple deliveries.
actions.check: Request ten units; record confirmation for ten and receipts for three and four. Show seven received, three outstanding.
actions.risk: Unmapped item IDs can conceal partial deliveries.

actions.action: Assign substitution decisions to a named teammate
actions.mechanism: Keep substitutions pending until someone other than the requester approves them with a preserved rationale.
actions.implementation: Record original and substitute IDs, quantity equivalence, requester, named decision owner, decision, rationale, and timestamp. Block self-approval; preserve previous decisions.
actions.check: Attempt requester approval and verify rejection. Receive an unapproved substitute; verify it remains visible but does not fulfill the original item.
actions.risk: An absent decision owner can delay resolution.

actions.action: Quarantine duplicate and excess receipt quantities
actions.mechanism: Check receipt identity before counting quantities; route over-deliveries to an explicit exception rather than silently closing requests.
actions.implementation: Stage receipts using supplier, receipt number, and line ID. Hold duplicate keys for review; flag quantities exceeding the remaining approved requirement.
actions.check: Import one receipt twice: totals stay unchanged. Receive twelve against ten requested: show twelve physically received and two excess awaiting disposition.
actions.risk: Different identifiers for the same receipt require manual review.

actions.action: Give every unresolved request a next step
actions.mechanism: Separate fulfillment from administrative closure, with named owners and explicit resolution of outstanding items and exceptions.
actions.implementation: Create a shared action queue for shortages, pending substitutions, and excess quantities. Assign an existing teammate and review date; require reasons for closure.
actions.check: Try closing a partially delivered request without a remainder decision: reject closure. Explicitly cancel its remainder; retain the shortage and cancellation history.
actions.risk: Premature cancellations can hide unmet needs unless reviewed.
